card.name: Hyphen or plus before a trailing digit
card.fires_on: A hyphen, plus sign, or letter such as B that sits just before a final number or letter in a code or name. Examples are Vitamin B1, free T4, C-IV, FMR-1 and phone prefixes like +49.

modes.label: Vitamin and hormone names
modes.description: The B in a vitamin name or the hyphen before T4, right before the number or letter that completes it.

modes.label: Hyphen in codes and gene names
modes.description: A hyphen or plus joining a short label to its number or letter, as in schedule C-IV or FMR-1.

modes.label: Arithmetic and phone prefixes
modes.description: A plus or minus sign inside an expression or before a country code.

card.writes: It favors a short symbol or letter next to a comma and suppresses space and filler tokens, which fits a code that is still being completed.
card.plain: It marks the joining dash, plus or letter in short codes like Vitamin B1, T4 or C-IV, just before the last character.
